summary: Phase 3 implementation is correct and complete. All FR-7/8/9/10/11 behavioral and structural requirements are satisfied, targeted tests pass, and the phase gates are green. One blocker was found during review-a: the FR-7 and FR-8 source-lint tests introduced 6 new tsc errors (TS2591/TS2304 from CommonJS require()/__dirname in a package without @types/node). This was fixed in a focused follow-up commit by converting to ESM node:fs import (with an explanatory @ts-ignore) and import.meta.url path resolution, restoring tsc to the 247-line baseline.

FR-7 correctness.notes: rational-analyzer.ts draws aNum, aDen ∈ {1,2,3}; horizontalAsymptote.ratio varies across seeds. rational-analyzer.test.ts asserts ratios.size > 1 over seeds 1-50 and at least one ratio ≠ 1. Adapter grades HA as number | 'none' with numeric_tolerance 0.001; adapter.test.ts asserts scalar target.

FR-8 correctness.notes: exp-log-solver.ts no longer contains while(true), isDomainValid, seed += 1, or eslint-disable no-constant-condition. exp-log-solver.test.ts uses vi.spyOn(prng, 'seededRandom') and asserts exactly one call per generation.

FR-9 correctness.notes: Single shared definitions: utils/prng.ts (seededRandom), utils/coefficients.ts (generateCoefficients), utils/polynomial-format.ts (formatPolynomial). Call sites updated: polynomial-operations.ts, polynomial-division.ts, rational-analyzer.ts, exp-log-solver.ts, knowledge-space/generators/registry.ts, knowledge-space/generators/advanced-math-adapters.ts, problem-families/im1/generators.ts. Determinism preserved — existing tests pass unchanged.

FR-10 correctness.notes: All 4 advanced adapters have non-empty nodeIds (12 total). Each ID was verified to exist in apps/integrated-math-3/curriculum/skill-graph/nodes.json. Flat packages/math-content/src/generator-registry.ts is deleted and index.ts no longer re-exports GENERATOR_REGISTRY/GeneratorEntry.

FR-11 correctness.notes: PRNG docstring in utils/prng.ts now accurately describes JS double-precision overflow behavior; implementation and bit pattern are unchanged.

Test integrity.notes: New rational-analyzer tests assert non-trivial HA variation, not no-ops. New exp-log test uses a real vi.spyOn counter. New adapter tests assert non-empty nodeIds and math.im3.skill.* pattern. No expect(true).toBe(false) sentinels remain in the changed files.

No spec drift.notes: FR-7/8/9/10/11 implementation matches the spec and Phase 3 plan; no scope expansion.

Phase 1 + 2 invariants.notes: FR-3 balanced-brace JSDoc guard reports 0 violations on 664 typed tags. Phase 2 multi-module + learner-state-union tests pass: 22/22.

No new tsc errors.notes: Baseline 247 lines. Review-a initially measured 253 lines (6 new TS2591/TS2304 errors from require()/__dirname in source-lint tests). Fixed in commit a93af1f2; current tsc --noEmit is back to 247 lines, matching baseline.

blockers_found.description: FR-7/FR-8 source-lint tests used CommonJS require('fs')/require('path') and __dirname, which introduced 6 new tsc errors in packages/math-content because @types/node is not installed.
blockers_found.resolution: Converted to ESM 'node:fs' import (with explanatory @ts-ignore) and import.meta.url path resolution. tsc baseline restored to 247 lines.

The only change made by review-a was in the two source-lint test files (rational-analyzer.test.ts and exp-log-solver.test.ts) to remove new tsc errors; no production behavior or test assertions changed.
